Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Signed and dated informed consent for participation in the study (separate informed consents for child  [OR] and parents/caregivers), obtained before conducting any study procedures
  -  Verified and documented diagnosis (neuromuscular desease, [OR]  NMD) with the results of neurologic examination
  -  Deformity of thoracic  [OR] and/or lumbar spine associated with NMD, which requires surgical intervention
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patient unwillingness  [OR] or inability to follow study procedures
  -  Absence of signed and dated informed consent for participation in the study (as for child  [OR] and for parents/caregivers)
  -  Patient participation in another clinical study, which can influence the results of this study
  -  Left ventricle ejection fraction less than 40% by echocardiography
  -  FEV >20
  -  Life expectancy <12 months
  -  Liver insufficiency: ALT, [OR]  AST  [OR] and total bilirubin twice higher than normal
  -  Kidney insufficiency (creatinine clearance <60 ml/min)
  -  Concomitant diseases, which preclude patient participation in this study according to doctor's opinion
